title: L'homme qui a attaqué une garderie suisse a trouvé ses victimes sur ChatGPT

reports.title: Messerangriff auf Kinder: Täter «kaufte Rindfleisch, um zu üben»
Chinese hatte Tat zusammen mit ChatGPT geplant!
Zürich-Oerlikon: Angriff auf Kinder eines Kinderhortes mit Verletzungsfolgen
L'homme qui a attaqué une garderie suisse a trouvé ses victimes sur ChatGPT

summary:
A 23-year-old Chinese student is on trial in Zurich for attempted murder after stabbing three five-year-old boys on 1 October 2024 in Oerlikon. He used a knife with an 8.5 centimetre blade, seriously injuring all three. One boy had a vein at his collarbone completely cut and needed emergency surgery, another was stabbed twice in the chest and nearly died from heart and blood vessel damage, and the third suffered wounds to his ear and lung. A childcare worker grabbed the attacker's arms, making him drop the knife and surrender until police arrived.

Prosecutors say he planned the attack for weeks, using ChatGPT to ask about legal consequences of stabbing random victims and choosing children as targets. He bought clothes and a set of kitchen knives, studied anatomy, and bought raw beef to practise stabbing the day before. The prosecution describes him as extremely cold-blooded and motivated by revenge, a need for attention, and ideological delusion. He is due in court on Thursday, where prosecutors are demanding a 15-year prison sentence and a 15-year expulsion from Switzerland.
title_en: The man who attacked a Swiss daycare found his victims on ChatGPT
